headline: Elemental HERO Neos
title: Elemental HERO Neos Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Elemental HERO Neos. What is it? It is a Level seven LIGHT Warrior Normal Monster with two thousand five hundred attack. Jaden switched to a Neo-Spacian deck built around Contact Fusion. What does it do? It has no effect, but it is the core of Contact Fusion with Neo-Spacians. How do you use it? The field spell Neo Space gives Neos and Fusions that list Neos five hundred attack. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
